reason: Owner could not name an answer to three 1 November Daily prompts. Accessible everyday categories take precedence over exhaustive specialist rosters.
familiarityReview: Every prompt has at least two explicitly named everyday answers rated 1–19. Additional familiar anchors are rated at most 40. Each maximum is explicitly chosen within its question. Unanchored answers remain neutral 50. No player-survey claim.
playerCutoffs: No dates, Unicode versions or through-2024 style restrictions in any active prompt or scope.
calendar: Epoch 1 November, continuing the earlier accessible schedule by two slots. The two 30/31 October sets return on 17/18 December, 48 days after those dates. New captures use the bank immediately; existing captures stay frozen. Midnight Australia/Sydney Daily reset remains unchanged.

facts: Milan and Cortina d’Ampezzo are accepted Olympic host cities after the completed 2026 Winter Games.
Toy Story 5, Hoppers and The Super Mario Galaxy Movie are accepted animated films with human characters, released in 2026.
Recent human-character films also include Elio and KPop Demon Hunters (2025).

preservation: No save version, account keys, SQL schema, timers or scoring formula changes. All prior full snapshots, pending rounds, completed results and zeroes keep their canonical answers and captured ratings. Prior alias-recovery tables remain recovery-only. Revision 11 bank/source/generator/runtime are archived.
limitations: Offline curated lists are generous but finite; arbitrary valid phrasing cannot be guaranteed.
Familiarity and rarity are editorial estimates, not measured population data.
Future facts after 1 November 2026 require later content review.
